newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London weak after Tokyo falls.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London weak after Tokyo falls.

text.p: Japanese shares in London were generally lower on Thursday, led by blue chips and after a sharp decline in Tokyo amid currency worries.
London's Nikkei/Ise 50 index was off 10.29 points at 1,426.0 by 1525 GMT after the Nikkei-225 share average lost 220.41 points or 1.05 percent to finish at 20,771.11.
"Activity is still relatively quiet," said one trader. "But we've been seeing selling in most sectors, blue chips, autos and pharmaceuticals especially."
The sell-off in Tokyo was led by currency worries after a Finance Ministry official said the dollar's rally against the yen was ending.
"This is having a big effect," one dealer said. "But people are not selling aggressively, they are taking profits on stocks that have been performing well recently," he added.
Auto's, pharmaceuticals and other blue chip stocks were especially weak, traders said.
